description: Uses synthetic canaries derived only from declared credential identity/field/scope metadata, runs LPBS and migrated service-owner identity contracts for audience, scope, source, versioned overlap, outage, restart and recovery, and scans every bounded subprocess output before returning metadata-only receipts.

notApplicableKinds.reason: Paid credential resolution, subprocesses and evidence serialization belong to the LPBS scenario.

concurrency.reason: The proof launches bounded LPBS Go test subprocesses and scans their output; it must not overlap another LPBS assurance run.

determinism.reason: The owner suites are repeatable and use deterministic synthetic canaries derived only from declared family metadata; no real credential source is read.

levels.name: Unverified
